summary: Refactored WebSocketAgentClient by extracting WebSocket, request, and parsing logic into a new `websocket/` subdirectory, keeping the public class and import path stable. Updated the corresponding test file, removed an unchecked WebSocket cast, and verified with check, tests, and prettier.
decisions: Split WebSocketAgentClient's responsibilities into modules under `apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/websocket/` (transport, request-client, session-requests, project-requests, resource-requests, git-requests, response-parsers) to keep all refactored/new files under 300 LOC.
Removed an unchecked WebSocket test cast in the WebSocketAgentClient test file and dropped the file from 330 to 291 LOC.
Kept the WebSocketAgentClient public class, its import path, and the AgentClient implementation stable to preserve behavior.
Did not commit the refactor; left unrelated worktree changes untouched.
errors: `wc -l` over `apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/websocket/*` exited with code 1 (likely the directory glob matched no files at the time), though individual files inside the directory were reported successfully.
